summary: Iteration 11 frontend-only testing for Quantro landing: IntelligenceSection (new) + PricingSection (redesigned). All functional requirements PASS in both ES and EN. Backend Stripe /api/stripe/create-checkout regression confirmed working (returns {url, session_id}).
action_items: (Observation only, not a bug) Problem statement notes 'Default language es' but actual default on a fresh session with cleared localStorage is EN. This is likely navigator.language-based auto-detect (headless Chrome defaults to en-US). Confirm with product whether default should be hard-coded to 'es' or remain locale-based. ES toggle works perfectly via data-testid='lang-toggle-es'.
critical_code_review_comments: PricingSection CTA handler passes hardcoded packageId: 'trial_1usd' for ALL three tiers (Starter/Pro/Scale) and all billing periods. Every plan triggers a $1 trial checkout instead of real per-plan prices. This is a real UX/monetization issue — user expects $59/$209/$499 checkout amounts but Stripe returns US$1.00 payment screen for every tier. Likely intentional (trial offer) but worth a comment/TODO in code.

IntelligenceSection.jsx: FlowVisualization nodes render labels with CSS uppercase class ('uppercase tracking-widest'), so the DOM source strings 'Datos/Análisis/Decisión/Acción' are displayed as 'DATOS/ANÁLISIS/DECISIÓN/ACCIÓN'. Matches spec intent (labels appear uppercase like the 'IMPULSADO POR AOS' small label). No action needed; just noting for next testers doing text assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IntelligenceSection and redesigned PricingSection are fully working. Testable selectors: data-testid='intelligence-section', 'intelligence-card-0..3', 'pricing-section', 'pricing-tier-0..2', 'pricing-price-starter|pro|scale', 'pricing-cta-0..2', 'billing-toggle-monthly|annual', 'pricing-annual-badge', 'lang-toggle-es|en'. Default lang on fresh session is EN (locale-based); click lang-toggle-es to switch. DOM section order verified: hero → (social-proof) → problem-system → value-stack → interactive-demo → cinematic-transition → amanecer → intelligence → (success-stories) → features → (differentiation) → pricing → faq (parens = sections without id attribute but present via data-testid). ES verified: title 'Un sistema que piensa en tu negocio.', 4 cards with expected titles, brand reveal 'Esto es Quantro Intelligence.' + 'IMPULSADO POR AOS' (CSS-uppercased), closing lines, pricing title 'Activa Quantro en tu negocio.', inclusion strip, taglines per plan, $59/$209/$499 monthly w/ '/mes', $590/$2,090/$4,990 annual w/ '/año' + '2 meses gratis' badge, Pro tier elevated (scale-[1.04], #00F5FF border, 'Más popular' badge with ⭐), 'Empezar' CTAs, key phrase 'No eliges más herramientas. / Eliges cómo quieres que funcione tu negocio.', microcopy 'Sin configuración compleja. Empiezas en minutos.'. EN verified: title 'Turn Quantro on in your business.', 'Get started' CTAs, EN taglines, 'Powered by AOS'. Stripe CTA fires POST /api/stripe/create-checkout (captured 1 request per click) and returns valid Stripe session URL.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. All 22 feature requirements from the review request validated as working.
